# ModelWire

> LLMのモデル・価格・提供終了を、追記専用で記録し続ける

## Models with an announced end of life

Source: the official deprecation pages of openai, anthropic, x-ai and cohere.
158 lifecycle records are tracked; 57 have a retirement date still
in the future. A qualifier such as "not sooner than" means the provider has NOT committed to
that date — it is reproduced as published and never converted into a firm date.

## What this site can answer

- When, and by how much, a specific LLM model's price changed
- When a model was added to a provider's catalog, and when it disappeared
- When a context window or max output limit was changed
- Current prices across providers, normalized to a single unit (USD per 1M tokens)

## Facts

- Tracking started: 2026-08-09
- Days of coverage: 2
- Models tracked: 400
- Change events recorded: 42
- End-of-life records tracked: 158
- Collection frequency: twice daily
- Price and catalog source: OpenRouter public API (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models)
- End-of-life source: provider deprecation pages (openai, anthropic, x-ai, cohere)
- Price unit: USD per 1,000,000 tokens

## Important property

The ledger is append-only. Once an observation is recorded it is never rewritten or deleted —
this is enforced by database triggers, not by convention. Past prices cannot be silently revised.

- Change feed (JSON): https://chorddote.github.io/modelwire-site/changes.json
- Latest snapshot (JSON): https://chorddote.github.io/modelwire-site/data/snapshot-latest.json

## Note

ModelWire is an unofficial project and is not affiliated with any listed provider.
Only factual values obtained from public APIs are stored and redistributed.
